QUOTE: The test suites use `TEST_CF_SECRET` and `TEST_CF_PUBLIC` markers (`tests/suites/test_suite_constant_time.function`), which mark memory as undefined under Valgrind or MSan. A secret-dependent branch or memory index is then reported as an error.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says verification is via Valgrind/MSan tests, but it never says the facility is off-by-default or that it is explicitly not part of the library API.
